name: @gears-frontx/frontx-template-site-meta
description: Page metadata for a FrontX site as one tooling package: from the seo block of every screen extension and a site config it generates the document head, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt, seo-manifest.json, the web manifest and a plain-text twin of every outline page into the build output, checks them against their sources, and carries the head-sync runtime that keeps the head equal to the page the address shows. Apply onto a project that already has template-shell applied; the package lands in the shell's workspace root for template-delivered packages and contributes no screen.
